subtitle: Halloween Crochet Pattern
tagline: Free crochet pattern | Leftover yarn | Printable
title: Crochet Spider Web
name: Spider Web
seoTitle: Easy Crochet Spider Web Pattern for Halloween (Free PDF)
description: Free, easy crochet spider web pattern for Halloween: dc spokes with growing chain spaces and a picot edge, plus a long hanging string. Printable PDF.
lead: A quick Halloween spider web. Each round adds longer chains between the spokes, and the last round gives every spoke a little picot. A long string lets you hang it.
notes: The beginning chains count as the first dc and its chain space. Join each round with a sl st in the 3rd ch.

rounds.text: ch 6 (counts as dc + ch 3), (dc in next st, ch 3) x5, sl st in the 3rd ch.
ch 8 (counts as dc + ch 5), (dc in next dc, ch 5) x5, sl st in the 3rd ch.
ch 10 (counts as dc + ch 7), (dc in next dc, ch 7) x5, sl st in the 3rd ch.
ch 3, (ch 3, skip 1 ch, sl st) for a picot, ch 7, then (dc in next dc, picot, ch 7) x5. sl st to join and fasten off.
ch 80. Starting in the 2nd ch from the hook: inc in each of the next 2 ch, then sl st in each of the last 77 ch.

finishing: Tie the string to the top of the web.
